_readme: FIAT CAMPAIGN ART (13 Oct, docs/design/campaign_gates.md): the tin glyph and the nine rail glyphs for the rooms as they're named now (art/ui_new/, 64 x 64; nothing in art/ui is touched - move the keepers over and Claude rewires GLYPH_OF), the five unlock items (art/items/, 128 x 128 as the deeds, new names), the Gamekeeper's portrait (art/people_new/, in the Fence's portrait style).
The rail glyphs for the Yard, Workshop, Clinic, Fence and Radio are the things that open them, drawn simpler for 38 px.

Run: godot --headless --script res://tools/pixellab_batch_v2.gd ++ --manifest res://tools/pixellab_campaign_manifest.json   (++ --dry-run to list). A job whose file exists is skipped; one that came out wrong: ++ --only <name> ++ --force.

jobs.description: A realistic painted pixel-art still-life of a rolled property deed on thick cream paper, tied with faded pink legal ribbon, a cracked red wax seal on the ribbon. One object centred and filling the frame, a single bold silhouette that still reads at a quarter of this size, soft directional overcast daylight, natural material rendering with painterly shading; no black outlines, no flat cel shading, not anime, not a cartoon, not a glossy video-game icon; the look of a real object photographed on a grey day in a country that has run out of money. Muted cool northern palette, worn and repaired, nothing new. Nothing else in the frame, no hands, no person, no text, no logos, a plain dark neutral background.
jobs._where: the rail: The Yard (opened by the deeds)

jobs.description: A realistic painted pixel-art portrait, head and shoulders, of the Gamekeeper, a lean weathered man in his sixties who kept the shoot on Top Farm's land and keeps it for himself now: a tweed cap, a waxed jacket gone pale at the seams, a shotgun broken over his shoulder, a dog lead looped round his neck, close-cut white beard, eyes that watch the hedges. Looking just past the viewer. Post-collapse Britain, overcast light. One person centred, filling the frame, no text, no border, plain dark background.
